text:
Priya R.: Quick sync — we need to lock the MVP for the Console observability work (dashboards + tracing hooks + cost breakdown). Customers are pushing for something lightweight we can ship in 2 sprints.
Marc L.: +1. Which customer asks are must-haves vs nice-to-have?
Jess C.: From CS: Aurora Health needs per-route cost and a way to link high-cost requests to traces. They said 'if we can't show spike -> trace, they won't buy Dedicated'.
Devon S.: Technical note: end-to-end trace linking adds overhead. We can do low-sample trace capture + a deterministic link id in logs to trace ID. Low lift: prefix KV + sampling.
Alex (sre): Also want an alerting hook for cost-per-minute spikes. Prefer threshold + short rolling window.
Priya R.: Proposal for MVP (2 sprints): 1) cost-by-route dashboard (top 20 routes), 2) 1% trace sampling for high-cost routes with link id in logs, 3) an SRE alert for cost spike (configurable).
Marc L.: OK technically feasible. Need acceptance criteria.
Priya R.: Acceptance criteria draft: 
```
- Cost dashboard shows top 20 routes, updated < 2m
- Drilldown: clicking route shows recent traces (sampled) and cost breakdown by token/type
- Trace sampling: 1% baseline, 10% for routes above cost threshold
- Alert: config threshold, alert fires within 5m of sustained spike (>3m)
- Docs: rollout playbook + customer-facing how-to
```
Devon S.: One caveat: 'click shows recent traces' requires trace storage retention at least 24h for sampled traces — ops cost needs signoff.
Alex (sre): Confirm retention and egress cost. Ops estimate: additional ~0.5-1 VCPU compute + S3 storage delta of ~20GB/day for initial customers.
Jess C.: We'll prioritize Aurora for an early canary. They agreed to be in a pilot for 30 days.
Marc L.: Implementation plan: sprint 1 = cost aggregation + dashboard UI + alert plumbing; sprint 2 = tracing hook + sampling control + docs + canary. Are we ok?
Priya R.: Sounds good. Who owns rollout gating? We need a clear canary checklist.
Alex (sre): I'll own canary gating. Checklist items: data accuracy checks (route mapping), alert noise <= 2/day, trace link success rate >= 95% for sampled items.
Devon S.: I'll add a runtime flag to flip sampling rates per-route and expose via Console. PR to track: https://git.internal/r/redwood/console/pulls/662
Priya R.: Great. Timeline: start Monday. Can we commit to ship to canary cluster by end of sprint 2 (4 weeks)?
Marc L.: Yes if no major infra surprises.
Jess C.: I'll schedule Aurora kickoff next Tue and prep acceptance test plan from their side.
Priya R.: Final asks: (1) add a minimal public doc snippet for 'how to read cost dashboard' (2) UX: top 3 callouts for anomalies, not full page. Keep scope tight.
Devon S.: Noted. I'll mock quick UX copy.
Alex (sre): Will prepare cost estimate for the sales deck.
Priya R.: Cool — I'll capture action items and own the roll-up. Thanks all :rocket:
